Your trees

Buy a tree

10 meme species

Every tree is a ridiculous character that “works” for a cycle of days. Bought trees are delivered to your 📦 Warehouse, then you plant them on a free plot. Tap any tree to see its price, growth time, harvest and profit. Typical result and best case are shown on each tree. On average trees return about +13–34% per cycle, paid in GROVE. No guaranteed profit: luck and sickness still matter.

Every tree has a 0.01% chance to turn out to be THE BROKEN TREE.

Inventory

Collect items from harvests, mystery eggs and Harvest Events. Use them on your trees or keep the rare ones.

Economy

Where the money goes

Each tree purchase is split: 70% reserve · 20% Reward Pool · 10% treasury. Upgrade, bailout and plot spending: 50% pool · 30% reserve · 20% treasury.
